subject: Energy
title: Enhanced Geothermal
description: A quick, practical guide to Enhanced Geothermal.

hook.text: Enhanced geothermal drills deep into hot rock and injects water—creating artificial geothermal reservoirs anywhere.

buildup.text: Traditional geothermal needs natural hot springs—but Earth's heat exists everywhere, just deeper underground.

discovery.text: EGS borrows fracking techniques—hydraulic stimulation creates fractures that let water circulate through hot rock.

twist.text: Fervo Energy connected an EGS plant to Nevada's grid in 2023—proving that engineered geothermal works commercially.

climax.text: EGS could provide 24/7 clean power anywhere on Earth—baseload energy without sun, wind, or fuel dependencies.

punchline.text: Drill deep, add water, get steam—geothermal everywhere.

quiz.question: What does enhanced geothermal borrow from the oil industry?
